messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Detected spike in 5xx rate for /v1/generate (us-east-1). 5m error rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~18%. Error signature: upstream gateway timeouts (504). Auto-escalation to on-call.
Erin SRE: I’m on it, digging into gateway -> upstream provider. Not seeing any infra scaling events.
Mike Eng-Oncall: grabbing handoff in 2m if you need to run. Erin, any quick mitigation you want me to enact?
Erin SRE: Try temporarily throttling traffic to the affected model route and enable fallback_model_variant in the router policy. Also mute noisy alert channel for 15m while we triage.
Samir Runtime: I can push a routing rule: route with weight 0.8 to primary, 0.2 to fallback. Will do a canary shift.
Jules Support: FYI customers are reporting timeouts. I’ve flagged 3 customers (acct-234, acct-998, acct-612) to CS. They’re seeing request failures during that window.
Mike Eng-Oncall: Applying routing change now. Command:
```
# apply ephemeral routing override
redwoodctl routing override --route /v1/generate --region us-east-1 --variant fallback --weight 20 --ttl 900
```
Mike Eng-Oncall: override pushed, monitoring.
Erin SRE: Good. Also add 2s client-side retry to gateway for upstream 504s for a short window. Opsbot, can you create a muted alert for channel for 15m?
ops-bot: OK: created temporary alert suppression (alert id: as-4721) for channel #eng-oncall, duration 15m.
Samir Runtime: I’m tailing gateway logs, seeing bursts of 504s with matching origin header pointing to provider A (provider-a-inference). Latency at provider is spiking to 3-6s before timeout.
Erin SRE: So root cause likely provider A instability. Immediate mitigation is routing away and retry. Monitoring whether fallback variant increases error-free throughput.
Mike Eng-Oncall: Post-change metrics look better: 5xx dropped to ~2.7% in us-east-1 in last 2 mins. P95 latency back to baseline.
Jules Support: Noting customer impact: 12 customers had elevated latency; 2 customers saw failed requests during the peak. I’ll open RCA tickets for those two.
Erin SRE: Great. We’ll keep the routing override for 30m then gradually roll back if stable. Also we need a follow-up to tune alerts so this doesn’t blast the channel on every provider glitch.
Mike Eng-Oncall: Agreed. Current alert: "5xx ratio > 5% over 5m" firing across all regions. That was noisy and prevented quick signal/slot. Suggest changes: regional thresholds, sliding window smoothing, and a secondary alert that triggers only if customer-impacting/errors on production routes > X.
Samir Runtime: Also add an upstream-specific alert: provider-a error rate or latency increase. We can surface origin headers in Grafana and alert on origin:provider-a 5xx% > 10% over 3m.
Erin SRE: Action items from live incident: 1) Temporary suppression ensured triage could proceed. 2) Routing override + retries mitigated impact. 3) CS informed affected customers. Next: postmortem + alert tuning.
Mike Eng-Oncall: Handoff: I’ll take on post-incident follow-up. Erin, if you want to take ownership of runbook updates for provider failures?
Erin SRE: I’ll own runbook updates (add provider-specific playbook, routing override snippet, recommended retry params).
Jules Support: I’ll update the customer-impact ticket with timeline and mitigation steps.
Samir Runtime: I’ll create a Grafana dashboard panel that breaks down 5xx by origin and by route, add a timeseries anomaly detection on provider latency.
Mike Eng-Oncall: Proposed alert tuning (post-incident):
- Keep primary 5xx alert but change to: 5xx ratio > 8% over 5m AND absolute failed requests > 100 in region.
- Add origin-specific alert: provider-a 5xx% > 10% over 3m (separate channel to #eng-runtime).
- Add rolling median smoothing (3m) to reduce spikes from short blips.
- Add escalation rule: if customer-facing errors > 0.5% for > 10m -> pager.
Erin SRE: +1 on those. Also create a dashboard quick toggle for "route throttle" and "fallback traffic" to see where overrides are applied.
ops-bot: Created follow-up ticket: INF-2024 - "Tune 5xx/timeout alerts and add provider-specific dashboards" assigned to Mike Eng-Oncall. Due date 3 business days.
Mike Eng-Oncall: I’m going to schedule a short postmortem doc: timeline, root cause (provider A degraded), mitigation steps, alert changes, runbook updates, customer impact. Will assign owners.
Jules Support: Noting customers who require external comms: acct-234 and acct-612. I’ll draft a customer note and route to legal if needed.
Erin SRE: Quick notes to add to runbook: recommended client-side retry policy: 2 retries with exponential backoff starting at 200ms for 504s; circuit breaker threshold 20% errors for 1m per route. Also add a checklist for temporary alert suppression and manual routing override steps.
Samir Runtime: For Grafana panels, I’ll add: origin 5xx heatmap, host-level latencies, overlay of routing overrides, and a derived metric for 'customer visible failures' using 4xx/5xx + token count.
Mike Eng-Oncall: Final status: mitigation stable, rolling back override scheduled in 30m unless errors reappear. Severity downgraded to Sev3. I’ll post the postmortem link in this thread when ready.
Erin SRE: Thanks all. Follow-ups: INF-2024 (alerts/dashboard) Mike, RUNBOOK-88 (provider failures) Erin, CS-442 (customer comms) Jules.
Jules Support: Thanks team. Reopen thread if anything spikes again.
ops-bot: Suppression as-4721 ended (15m). Alerts will resume monitoring.
Mike Eng-Oncall: Confirming no new spikes. Marking incident mitigated at T+28m. I’ll create the postmortem draft now.
Erin SRE: Handing to Mike for postmortem and follow-ups. Oncall clear from my side.
Mike Eng-Oncall: Oncall takeover confirmed. Continuing with follow-up tasks.
